description: This file defines a custom exception class 'WebAppConfigurationException' which extends the 'GeneralException' class. It is used for handling configuration-related errors in the web application module of the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: WebAppConfigurationException
classes.description: A specialized exception class for web app configuration errors, extending GeneralException and providing constructors to wrap underlying throwable causes.

methods.description: Constructor that creates a new instance of WebAppConfigurationException, wrapping a provided Throwable.
